To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
KSHV-encoded microRNAs can regulate the expression of their target genes by modulating the protein-protein interaction (PPI) network and the topological properties of the target genes in the network.

KSHV-encoded microRNAs (miRNAs) are involved in the regulation of a variety of cellular processes, including immune response, cell proliferation and apoptosis, which is consistent with their roles in KSHV pathogenicity.
KSHV-encoded viral miRNAs are likely to play important roles in regulating the host cell cycle and immune responses, which are essential for KSHV to establish a latent infection in the host.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the functional dissection of human miRNA targets for KSHVs-encoded miRNAs,
the biological knowledge regarding KSHV-encoded viral miRNAs and the host-virus interactions.
the functional dissection of human cellular targets for KSHVs-encoded miRNAs by means of network analysis.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
KSHV-encoded microRNAs play a critical role in the pathogenesis of KSHV-associated malignancies and the network approach provides a powerful tool to investigate the biological functions of KSHVs.
KSHV-encoded microRNAs play important roles in the regulation of viral pathogenesis by modulating the expression of cellular target genes.
KSHV-encoded and host-encoded miRNA networks are highly overlapped, thus we can speculate that the miRNAs of KSHV and host may have similar roles in the regulation of cellular processes.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the CePPIN can help us to better understand the mechanism of miRNAs in KSHV pathogenic process.
the KSHV encoded miRNAs are involved in a variety of cellular processes, especially immune response, and the miRNA targets tend to be hubs in the CePPIN.
KSHV-encoded microRNAs can regulate the biological processes of host cells in a complex way and the functions of KHSV-encoded miRNAS can be classified into two generic categories.
The main takeaway from our work is that
KSHV-encoded microRNA can regulate cellular processes in a network-based manner and that the KSHV miRNA-regulated CePPIN provides a novel perspective on the functional mechanisms of KSHV infection.
the KSHV miRNA targets are not randomly selected from the human proteome, instead they are highly enriched in some important cellular processes and pathways.
the KSHV miRNA-mediated regulation of cellular targets is not random and the miRNA targets tend to be functionally important and highly connected in the network.
